passages.context: The complete numbered constitution and its adjacent headings were inspected. Donaldson's English witness says an exorcist is not ordained as such, treats the capacity as a manifested gift, and distinguishes possible ordination to bishop, presbyter, or deacon. This controls one late-antique pseudonymous church-order prescription, not apostolic authorship, universal Eastern discipline, actual local frequency, Syriac or Coptic practice, or modern Roman law.
